Attachment.description: A sanitized attachment. ``stored_path`` is run-specific and excluded from output.
Attachment.title: Attachment

CodeBlock.description:
A fenced, indented or ``<pre>`` code block.

``span`` covers the block's raw lines in the body (without fence lines);
``content`` is the block text as the parser saw it (indentation of enclosing lists or
blockquotes removed), which usually equals ``span.text``.
CodeBlock.title: CodeBlock

CodeLocation.description: A location in the repository at an exact commit, with an upstream permalink.
CodeLocation.title: CodeLocation

CommandRecord.description: An external command a check ran, recorded so anyone can re-run it (P6).
CommandRecord.title: CommandRecord

DeclaredTarget.description: Target metadata supplied by the intake (not extracted from prose).
DeclaredTarget.title: DeclaredTarget

Frame.description: One stack frame, normalized across formats (SPEC §9.5).
Frame.title: Frame

MemoryRegion.description: ASan's ``0x… is located N bytes to the right of M-byte region [start,end)``.
MemoryRegion.title: MemoryRegion

Permalink.description: A GitHub or GitLab blob URL, which pins repo, ref, path and lines.
Permalink.title: Permalink

Report.description: A normalized vulnerability report. The reporter's identity is never stored.
Report.title: Report

ResolvedTarget.description: The repository and exact commit a report was checked against (SPEC §10).
ResolvedTarget.title: ResolvedTarget

SourceMap.description:
Maps offsets in the normalized body back to offsets in the original input. Segments are sorted and non-overlapping. Offsets that fall into text the normalizer inserted (e.g. a newline standing in for ``
``) map to the start of the next verbatim segment, or to the end of the input.
SourceMap.title: SourceMap

SourceSegment.description:
``length`` characters copied verbatim from ``orig_start`` in the original input to
``norm_start`` in the normalized body.
SourceSegment.title: SourceSegment

Span.description:
A half-open character range ``[start, end)`` of :attr:`Report.body`, with its text.

Invariant (checked by :class:`Report`): ``report.body[start:end] == text``.
Span.title: Span

Stack.description: A labelled stack other than the primary one (e.g. TSan's "previous write").
Stack.title: Stack

VersionSpec.description: A parsed version: numeric components, an optional qualifier, and the raw text.
VersionSpec.title: VersionSpec

description:
Everything Nikasha concluded about one report.

``timings`` is the only field allowed to differ between two runs on the same input.
title: Result
